_readme: Customer reviews shown on the homepage, copied from the Salla store (salla.sa/banaweer.sa/testimonials). Newest first. First names only, for the customers' privacy. 'en' is a translation of the original Arabic review.

reviews.en: Great! A bike that lives up to the brand's name.

reviews.ar: متجر ممتاز وسرعه في الرد علي الاستفسارات والمنتج كما بالوصف
reviews.en: Excellent store, quick to answer questions, and the product was exactly as described.
Excellent store, and the bike is great.
